title: Jamaican Chicken Fried Rice
description: A flavorful twist on the classic Chinese dish, featuring Jamaican spices and halal chicken.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic; cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the halal chicken breast; cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the bread; cook, breaking it up with a spatula, until it is well combined with the chicken and onions, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the Jamaican jerk seasoning and soy sauce; cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the cooked rice to a serving bowl; garnish with chopped scallions.
